confirmed_uncertainty.exact_text: How acceptable would potential customers find a hypothetical 12 oz takeaway iced latte priced at RM13?

qj.justification: The confirmed uncertainty (acceptability of a hypothetical RM13 12 oz takeaway iced latte) concerns customer perception, not profit, so it cannot substantiate profitability. Several frozen measurement fields are absent from the supplied sources: no response options, response codes, routing rules, denominator, timeframe, or source refs are defined, and no uncertainty_version identifier is provided for the confirmed uncertainty (only confirmation/assessment IDs). Geography is explicitly out of V1 scope, and location (M2V1-05), price-tolerance (M2V1-07) and (M2V1-10) answers are unknown. With incomplete frozen fields, the candidate cannot be assembled, so the item is held pending completion of the measurement specification.

validation.note: Structural validation by the repository validator. The adopted measurement policy is not implemented, so this is not a scientific acceptance and not an approved research question.
